name: Farrer Park
summary: NEL stop north of Rochor — mixed condo and older estate texture, food belts toward Little India / Jalan Besar, and city-fringe hops without Bugis mall crush.
body: Farrer Park is the shortlist when North-East Line access and a slightly more residential city-fringe feel matter, with Little India / Jalan Besar food in walking range. Housing mixes condos, older blocks, and estate edges; weekend cultural and food crowds are real but usually less mall-tourist than Bugis. Expats land here for NEL CBD hops and neighbourhood density rather than polished Orchard living. Compare with Lavender for EWL/DTL optionality, Bugis for retail interchange gravity, and Novena when you want medical / office belt polish further up the line.
